description: Change of use of a drinking establishment (use class A4) to use as a non-residential institution (use class D1).
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (104, 105, 106 and planning statement Received: 25th July 201)1  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for purposes ancillary to the existing prayer hall and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 4 - No amplified or any other music shall be played in the premises outside the following times: Monday to Sunday, 9.00am to 11.00pm and when played, shall be inaudible from the nearest residential property.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted in association with the existing prayer hall shall not be carried on outside the following times Monday to Sunday 9.00am to 11.00pm.
Condition : 6 - The use shall be carried on only by the Trustees of the Shree Jalaram Seva Trust.

Condition : 7 - No activity shall be carried out outside the existing buildings on the site without the prior written approval of the local planning authority.  Should the applicant wish to carry out activity outside these buildings on certain festival days or for other activities, the application for council permission shall include any means to mitigate against potential harm to residents through the activities of worshippers, including traffic management and parking control measures.

Condition : 8 - A fume extraction system shall be provided, before the  use is brought into operation, and when at maximum operation shall not result in noise that is more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details:

a) A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the building.

b) The point of discharge shall be a minimum of one metre above eaves level or one metre above openable windows of nearby properties.

c) The ducting shall be circular.

d) The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.

e) The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.

f) The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.

g) The duct shall be isolated from the structure of the building using anti-vibration mouldings and suitable packing material where it passes through solid structures.
Condition : 9 - No deliveries or collections, including refuse collection, shall take place between 9.00 pm and 07.00 am on any day and not at all on Sundays or public holidays.
Condition : 10 - The fire exit door from the kitchen shall remain shut except in cases of emergency
